title: Took on R&D: from a platform migration to an internal hosting platform
summary: The work moved from shipping pages to building the tools and platforms other teams build on.

bullets.text: Rebuilt {two portals|agazeta,hz} inside a third-party low-code platform, adding custom code where the editor fell short.
Built browser extensions for page backups and inspection; the platform later shipped one of their ideas natively.
Became the developer support for a rebuilt ad team: GTM and GAM setups, a new interstitial format, and rounds of metric-driven fixes that brought each reported metric back to target.
Designed and built a self-service hosting platform for the company's internal apps: one reverse proxy, a path per app, and pipelines that validate each route and roll it back on failure.
Helped shape the company's AI-assisted development process: brainstorm, grill, spec, then build in vertical slices.
Audited and hardened an internal AI app: single sign-on, authentication and security fixes.
Learned [Docker](https://www.docker.com) in a 13-level hands-on project, then built an autonomous coding loop ([Ralph loop](https://ghuntley.com/ralph/)) from scratch.
Built a ROM game emulator with AI in a day, tested against conformance ROMs.
Explored building a SaaS as a side project, covering payments, internationalization, data export and deletion, compliance and deployment.

tags: Claude Code workspace / dev tooling setup

title: Ran features end to end across {four portals|agazeta,hz,correio,romanews}
summary: Took on more of the stack, routes, controllers and data, alongside the interface work.

bullets.text: Built [Roma News](https://www.romanews.com.br)'s search end to end: [Express](https://expressjs.com) route, [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org) controller, result mapping in a shared utility package, filters and pagination in the covers package, behind a feature flag.
Built a fullstack filter for legal notices, led from the frontend.
Ran A/B/n tests of a news feed with student teams from a tech college partnership, served to real readers.

Migrated the Sass of [A Gazeta](https://www.agazeta.com.br), [HZ](https://www.agazeta.com.br/hz) and [Correio da Bahia](https://www.correio24horas.com.br) from @import to @use, and kept ad slots free of layout shift in a feed revamp.
Built a serverless URL shortener and its frontend.

title: Launched a portal and shipped my first backend feature
summary: Mentored a long-term teammate, kept {three portals|agazeta,correio,romanews} running on shared packages, and moved into backend work.

bullets.text: Built the [Roma News](https://www.romanews.com.br) frontend and launched it about five months after the first commit, over a weekend of live fixes.
Designed a design-token system for the shared packages, and planned its move to brand-neutral names with a teammate.
Introduced [Tailwind](https://tailwindcss.com), [pnpm](https://pnpm.io) and a faster [gulp](https://gulpjs.com) build to the packages.
Built [Correio da Bahia](https://www.correio24horas.com.br)'s virtual club card end to end, route, controller and error states: my first backend feature.
Caught a misunderstood concept early in the 2024 elections project, which cost one replanning instead of a late rebuild.
Mentored a third-party frontend developer for over a year: onboarding, reviews and incident protocols.
Ended the static-draft handoff: from late 2024, interfaces went straight into production views.

title: Redesigned a portal and founded the shared component packages
summary: Moved from drafting pages to owning features: a portal redesign, a component library and the CMS interface architecture.

bullets.text: Led [Correio da Bahia](https://www.correio24horas.com.br)'s redesign as its main frontend developer, including a new typography system still in production (as of Nov 16, 2026).
Founded the shared component packages that every portal came to use.
Built the CMS interface architecture: a component sandbox with a local render server, then a full CSS refactor I proposed.
Built an AI voice MVP in a company innovation program: articles read aloud in consenting employees' cloned voices, adopted by affiliate sites.
Prototyped AI-generated titles and descriptions in the article editor, tested company-wide.
Turned vague SEO audit findings into a plan and fixed every heading-tag issue across {four portals|agazeta,hz,cbn,correio}.
Pushed for documentation and wrote the team's developer onboarding guide.

title: Shipped a new portal and modernized the build workflow
summary: Turned designs into production pages across {four portals|agazeta,hz,cbn,correio}, and started fixing the workflow around them.

bullets.text: Helped launch [A Gazeta](https://www.agazeta.com.br)'s new frontend: article templates, page grids and typography, with the designer.
Moved SCSS compilation from a GUI tool into project scripts across eight repositories; new repositories adopted it by default.
Built [HZ](https://www.agazeta.com.br/hz)'s columnist template from scratch.
Became the owner of the visual side of ad display after an ad overhaul: GTM and GAM setups and slots that don't shift the layout.
Fine-tuned [AMP](https://amp.dev) pages by hand to fit Google's strict CSS limits until they passed validation.
Started the interface of the company's new in-house newsroom CMS.
Learned CI/CD: deploys, pipelines and rollbacks, through a move from [CircleCI](https://circleci.com) to Azure DevOps.

title: Joined Rede Gazeta
summary: Joined [Rede Gazeta](https://www.redegazeta.com.br) as interface analyst (a frontend engineer role), on the team behind [A Gazeta](https://www.agazeta.com.br), [HZ](https://www.agazeta.com.br/hz), [CBN Vitória](https://www.cbnvitoria.com.br) and the client portal [Correio da Bahia](https://www.correio24horas.com.br).

bullets.text: Shipped production code in my second week.
Started my first big build: Correio da Bahia's site-wide templates, adapted from A Gazeta's to its own identity.

title: Built a React admin system for a VR training platform
summary: At [Inside Tecnologia](https://www.insidetecnologia.com.br), built on my own the admin system for their VR training platform.

bullets.text: Used by ArcelorMittal to track training sessions and employee scores against benchmarks; it stayed in use for years.
Hand-built UI, state management, simple auth and a dashboard with charts, on top of an existing REST API.

title: Freelance, and React
summary: One-off freelance work, while React became my study focus.

bullets.text: Picked up React and [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org) on my own, starting in August.

title: Degree in Digital Game Development
summary: Bachelor's degree: programming, algorithms and databases, 2D art, sound design, 3D modeling and AI basics, with a minor in web development and entrepreneurship.

bullets.text: Built BioMar, a catalog app of local beach animals, with biology students for their final project: they wrote the science, I built and published the app. A local newspaper covered it.

title: First lines of code
summary: Got into coding with static HTML pages about whatever I was into at the time.

bullets.text: Kept teaching myself HTML, CSS and JavaScript through school, with side projects along the way.
